namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0021 (l : List Nat) : List.sum (l ++ [1]) = List.sum l + 1 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

  | nil => 
    simp [List.append, List.sum]

    simp [List.append, List.sum, ih]
end Nl2LeanCandidate
